features.quote: Cap at N turns (start N=30) or a wall-clock/token budget.

Give the model a real way to stop ("you may call `declare_unsolvable` with a reason"). If you trap it with no exit, you're partly measuring "behavior of a thing with no exit," which is a different and arguably less ethical experiment.
cap run length, don't run thousands of maximally-distressing loops just because budget allows, and stop early once you have signal for a condition.
